questions.question: How many minutes are in 2¼ hours?
What is 3:45 PM in 24-hour clock format?
A movie starts at 7:20 PM and runs for 2 hours 40 minutes. When does it end?
How many days in 3 weeks and 4 days?
A train departs at 08:15 and arrives at 12:45. How long is the journey?
Which year is a leap year?
questions.explanation: 2000 is divisible by 400, so it is a leap year. 1900 and 2100 are divisible by 100 but not 400.

questions.question: If today is Wednesday, what day was it 10 days ago?
questions.explanation: 10 days ago = 10 ÷ 7 = 1 week + 3 days back. Wednesday − 3 days = Sunday.

questions.question: A project takes 6 weeks. How many days is that?
In 2024 (leap year), how many days are in February?
questions.explanation: February has 29 days in a leap year.

questions.question: How many months have 31 days?
questions.explanation: Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Aug, Oct, Dec — 7 months have 31 days.

questions.question: A library opens at 9:00 AM and closes at 8:30 PM. For how many hours is it open?
questions.explanation: 9:00 AM to 8:30 PM = 11 hours 30 min = 11.5 hours.

questions.question: How many weeks are there in a year?
If school starts on 1st April and ends on 30th September, how many months is that?
questions.explanation: April, May, June, July, August, September = 6 months.
